title: Summer Heat Effects and Heat-Related Concerns
summary: This topic centers on hot-weather impacts and concerns, including cabin comfort during engine stop/start, possible heat-related electronic issues, and uncertain reports about range, charging, and component durability in summer conditions.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe summer heat making stop/start air conditioning uncomfortable and extreme desert heat affecting electronic components.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention heat-related concerns or possibilities involving touchscreen durability, reduced range with high cabin heat, charging rate influences, and a general hot-weather safety anecdote without a clear evaluation of the vehicle.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so the evidence is limited for drawing clear sentiment conclusions about heat-related performance.
The examples mix direct owner complaints with speculative concerns and a general safety anecdote, so the topic is not fully cohesive.
The sample is small and stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all G60 heat-related experiences.
